test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution: The correct answer is '**gratitude**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**gratitude**'. • It means** 'the feeling of being grateful or of wanting to give your thanks to somebody'.** (कृतज्ञता या किसी को धन्‍यवाद देने की इच्‍छा) • *Example: He smiled at them with **gratitude**.* • In the given sentence, Namita was very grateful to her friend for helping her out when she was in trouble. (दिए गए वाक्य में, नमिता अपने दोस्त की बहुत आभारी थी कि उसने मुसीबत में उसकी मदद की।) Correct Paragraph:__ *Namita did not have enough cash. She did not __have__ a credit card either. She found herself in a __fix__. She had the contact number of a __close__ friend whom she called for help. Her friend came __immediately__ and settled the bill. Namita thanked her and expressed her __**gratitude**__. She promised to return the money to her friend soon.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__*** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **solitude**: the state of being alone, especially when you find this pleasant. (अकेलापन (विशेषतः अच्‍छा लगने वाला)) • **aptitude**: natural ability or skill. (सहज अभिरुचि; रुझान, अभिक्षमता) • **attitude**: the way that you think, feel, or behave. (सोचने, अनुभव करने का तरीक़ा विशेष; रुख़, अभिवृत्ति, मनोवृत्ति, दृष्टिकोण) 4b:T15cc, **BODMAS RULE**
